sources.caption:
📣 Parents of Teenagers, This One’s for You! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

The teenage years come with new challenges, changing emotions, and plenty of moments where we may wonder, “Am I handling this the right way?” 💭

Join us for the Triple P Webinar Series, an evidence-based parenting programme designed to equip parents with practical strategies to better understand and support their teenagers’ emotional, social and psychological development.

✨ For parents with children aged 13–16 years old

📅 Session 1: 3 October 2026 (Saturday)
⏰ 10.00am – 12.30pm

📅 Session 2: 10 October 2026 (Saturday)
⏰ 10.00am – 12.00pm

💻 Online via Zoom

Each session builds on the previous one, so parents are highly encouraged to attend both sessions for the full learning experience. 🌱

Parenting a teenager doesn’t come with a manual, but with the right strategies, we can journey through these years with greater confidence, connection and understanding. ❤️

📲 Scan the QR code to register now!
